parent_objective: audit guarded-v2 measured execution against M2293 and M2298 target/guardrail slices
blocked_by: M2307 completed measured execution but global outcome does not show clear improvement and collision count increased versus M2293
supersedes: interpreting M2307 global aggregate as final repair verdict
running another repair before target/guardrail slice audit

public_gates: M2308 must audit M2307 completeness and claim boundary
M2308 must compare M2307 global outcome against M2293 without ranking profiles
M2308 must audit M2298 offtrack target and collision guardrail slices before route decision
M2308 must select a concrete non-ranking next route
M2308 must not run training reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits M2307 measured outcome against M2293 and the M2298 repair gate spec
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no rerun ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2307 artifacts are incomplete
stop if M2298 target/guardrail slices cannot be audited
stop if audit would treat global return or profile aggregate as final ranking
stop if the next route would be another training run without slice diagnosis or synthesis
fallback_plan: route to artifact-only target/guardrail slice diagnosis if direct audit needs row-level comparison
route to branch synthesis if M2307 clearly fails to improve scenario-task quality
route to bounded repair design only if audit identifies a new non-local-search blocker
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2307 measured execution completed with near-flat global success and higher collision count versus M2293

training_stage.stage_objective: audit M2307 guarded-v2 measured execution result and choose next route
admission_evidence: M2307 global success/offtrack/collision is 68/786/218 versus M2293 69/785/209
allowed_updates: M2308 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: M2307 completeness and guardrails are audited
M2307 versus M2293 global deltas are recorded
M2298 target and guardrail slice audit route is selected or completed

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2308 audits measured outcomes and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2308; no wrong-history reset-hidden or zero-history intervention is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2307 measured execution outputs and M2293/M2298 reference artifacts.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If guarded-v2 measured outcome is flat or worse, route to slice diagnosis or synthesis; do not lower self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level result finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: turns guarded-v2 measured outcome data into a route decision before further local search
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide whether guarded-v2 repair changed M2293 offtrack/collision slices or should synthesize/pivot
must_synthesize_if: M2308 would recommend another training run without slice diagnosis
M2308 would rank profiles despite diagnostic-only aggregates

hypothesis: M2307 provides enough measured outcome evidence to decide whether guarded-v2 repair merits target/guardrail slice diagnosis, branch synthesis, or bounded repair.
success_criteria: M2307 versus M2293 global success/offtrack/collision deltas are audited
M2298 target/guardrail slice route is decided
a follow-up non-ranking route is selected
failure_criteria: M2308 starts new training reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2308 ranks profiles or selects a winner
M2308 makes finite-window-vs-GRU paper-level or level3 self-ID claims
M2308 cannot select a next route

commands.name: audit
commands.command: manual artifact audit of runs/m2307_paper_route_current_sim_scenario_task_family_guarded_repair_measured_execution/summary.json and M2293/M2298 references

decision_rule: M2308 passes if it audits M2307 completeness and measured outcome deltas then selects a non-ranking follow-up route.
